sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Casterwill was the original and first Seeker responsible for bringing the Titans to Earth from the Spirit World, Huntik, in order to battle and defeat the Nullifiers. [All Work and No Pay] At some point in the conflict, Casterwill called for the assistance of Cherit. [Memory Lane]

Casterwill took 500 years to defeat the Nullifiers and to seal the Spiral Mark with the Willblade. [The Spiral Mark] When he finally did so, Casterwill died right where he was standing. [Coming of Age] Lord Casterwill's legacy was passed on to his sons and daughters, who each received a Legendary Titan to fight against the Nullifiers if they ever return. [The Spiral Mark]

Cherit had a several dreams remembering his time at the side of Lord Casterwill. [Memory Lane] It later led him to discover the Golden Asp where the Ring of Tao was buried. [The Golden Asp]

Lord Casterwill appeared to Sophie Casterwill in the Crystal Caves, signifying to her that she was a direct descendant of his. [Cave of the Casterwills]

On Avalon, Lord Casterwill's spirit appeared to Lok Lambert when he drew the Willblade, knighting him and empowering him to invoke Pendragon, the Legendary Titan of Champions. Although no one could remember the event, his spectral form watched Cherit at Dante Vale's house. [Knight of the Willblade]

The statue of Lord Casterwill in the Fortress of Iron Will later disapppeared to awaken Titans, Coralgolem, Icarus and Feyone as they stormed into battle against the Blood Spiral. [The Spiral War]

Casterwill appeared to Lok again in the Inter-dimensional World at Tír na nÓg, where he gave Lok the power to properly bond with Pendragon. [Back Home]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: Casterwill was the original owner of the [[Amulet of Will]] and the original Seeker bonded to the [[Legendary Titans]] as well as [[Cherit]]. Such powers permitted him to outlive normal human beings and to fight the Nullifiers for a full 500 years, maintaining himself alive for sheer force of will. {{source|Coming of Age}} In addition to his Titans, Casterwill and his descendants were capable of powerful and unique [[:Category:Casterwill family magic|Casterwill spells]], including curses, barriers, powerful offensive magic, and even the power to seal and unlock the [[Spiral Mark]] at will with the aid of the [[Willblade]].

sections.heading: Bonded Titans
sections.text:
Araknos — tv — hidden — Legendary Titan of Mind; sealed away inside Araknos' Tomb.

Behemoth — tv — hidden — Legendary Titan of Body; later obtained by Hippolyta's mother.

Cherit — tv — lost — Lord Casterwill's trusted companion; at some point his Amulet was lost, and Cherit somehow became anchored to Earth, roaming freely for over 60,000 years.

Mythras — tv — given away — Legendary Titan of Valor; Given to his youngest son.

Overlos — tv — hidden — Legendary Titan of Immortality; Casterwill's signature Titan and the most powerful known Titan of all; kept inside the Amulet of Will and hidden away in Atlantis.

Pendragon — tv — given away — Legendary Titan of Champions; Given to the Champion of Casterwill.

Phoenix — tv — given away — Legendary Titan of Rebirth; Given to his youngest daughter.

Quetzalcoatl — tv — given away — Legendary Titan of Summons; Given to his eldest daughter.

Tao — tv — hidden — Legendary Titan of Spirit; eventually hidden in King Solomon's mines.

Umbra — tv — given away — Legendary Titan of Dimensions; Given to his eldest son.

Grand Dragon Leviathan — comic — hidden — Legendary Titan of the Deeps; Sealed away beneath St. Mark's Basilica to protect it from the forces of dark magic.

Kronos — comic — hidden — Legendary Titan of Time; later hidden in the astronomical clock tower of Prague.
